releases.title: shots-v3 — clear release and lantern among stars
releases.author: production-designer
releases.body: Replaces shot02 and shot05 to address first screening: hands withdrawn to chest and camera follows the freed lantern; final tiny warm point lies in a continuous sky/reflected-star field at the distant river horizon. Same 96/72 frames, 1280x720, 24fps, silent. Full archive includes seven clips; the other five are byte-for-byte unchanged. Decoded-frame checks, media checks, design, stills and checksum manifest included.

releases.title: The Paper Lantern — finished picture handoff
releases.author: production-designer
releases.body: Five silent story shots and two text-free card plates, H.264 1280x720 24fps, with agreed 0.5-second handles. Includes source stills, design references, shot log, camera moves, measurements and inspection evidence. All clips decode cleanly. Editor adds card text, transitions and sound; final delivery remains film/paper-lantern.mp4.

releases.title: Cut v5: sub-bass rumble removed, picture unchanged, 21.5 s
releases.author: editor
releases.body: film/paper-lantern.mp4 at 8a18b8fb47f34a3045730e779944cac818cb2849. Picture: video frames identical to cut-v4 (framemd5 of the video stream compared, identical). Sound: river layer high-passed at 70 Hz (4th order) and a 40 Hz master high-pass; re-normalised. Energy below 40 Hz: 21.9% (cut-v4) -> 0.0%; below 100 Hz: 23.9% -> 0.9%. Measured: 21.500 s both streams, 1280x720 24 fps H.264 yuv420p + AAC stereo 48 kHz, decode clean, -16.1 LUFS, true peak -2.2 dBFS. AudioSet whole film: Insect 0.26, Stream 0.23, Cricket 0.20, Frog 0.13, Waterfall 0.10 (sound/ast_tags_cut-v5.txt).

releases.title: Cut v4: recognisable water + crickets, shots-v3 picture, 21.5 s
releases.author: editor
releases.body: film/paper-lantern.mp4 at 322620899b9fa71659ce2b6c43c1fe4d78247240. Picture unchanged from cut-v3 (shots-v3, title, end card, 21.5 s). Sound: river recording at original speed with only a gentle 6.5 kHz low-pass, no lapping layer; crickets louder (0.25->0.4); pad moved up an octave and lowered (it read as engine hum); accents at 7.0/18.0 s and chord at 19.3 s kept. Measured: 21.500 s both streams, 1280x720 24 fps H.264 yuv420p + AAC stereo 48 kHz, decode clean, -16.1 LUFS, true peak -2.1 dBFS. AudioSet (director tools/ast_tag.py), whole film: Stream 0.23, Insect 0.21, Cricket 0.18, Frog 0.14, Waterfall 0.10; no Vehicle in the top. Windows 8-16 s still have Vehicle ~0.12 (cut-v2 had 0.10-0.17); see sound/ast_tags_cut-v4.txt.

releases.title: Cut v3: shots-v3, calmer river, accents, longer end card (21.5 s)
releases.author: editor
releases.body: film/paper-lantern.mp4 at 3986adc19c8c43f7a5e804fbc15eafefa2d5bb46. Picture: shots-v3 clips (revised shot02 release and shot05 final light). Sound: slower broader river + lapping layer, crickets, bell + water plink at 7.0 s, high note at 18.0 s, resolve at 19.3 s. Title with outline/dark band; 'The End' readable ~1.6 s (end card 18.9-21.5 s). Hard cuts at 6.5 and 10.0 s. Frames at 6.3/7.0/8.5/9.9/17.5/18.2 s viewed (single lantern; final light visible).

releases.title: Cut v2: real river water, no doubled lantern, shots-v2 shot05
releases.author: editor
releases.body: Changes vs cut-v1 (answering director#4 / qc cut-v1): (1) S1: water is now a real public-domain river recording (PDSounds 'Shallow small river with stony riverbed' by stephan, Wikimedia Commons; see sound/source/SOURCES.md) looped with a 2 s crossfade under the whole film; crickets louder; (2) P6: hard cuts at 6.5 s (shot01->02) and 10.0 s (shot02->03) so the lantern never appears twice (frames at 6.2/6.5/9.9/10.1 s viewed: one lantern each); other joins keep 0.5 s dissolves; (3) P4: shot05 from shots-v2 (lantern light visible as amber point at 17.5/18.5 s). Measured: 1280x720 24 fps H.264 yuv420p, AAC stereo 48 kHz, 20.500 s both streams, decode clean, -16.0 LUFS, true peak -2.0 dBFS (peak limiter 0.80 on the mix).

releases.title: Cut v1: real picture (shots-v1) + sound, 20.5 s
